phase: journal durability and explicit preview recovery
changes: After atomic journal rename, fsync the containing directory before clearing the dirty flag; a sync failure preserves the in-memory dirty state and reports failure.
Keep the saved detached-preview preference after an unexpected child crash. Explicit Apply regenerates and reopens the detached preview without automatic crash-loop retries.
Make the crash-recovery test wait for both coupled scene allocation and detached preview readiness, avoiding an observation race.

display_loss_current_source.reason: The disposable Xvfb cannot create its lock under the full /tmp filesystem; -nolock is restricted to root. Existing Xephyr :61 and :68 were preserved. Earlier scoped display-loss proof remains in T09-PERDA-DISPLAY-20261011.json, but is not claimed as a fresh run against this source hash.

limits: The journal checkpoint is scheduled every 100 ms while the application is open; this is not a guarantee for a crash or power loss before a successful checkpoint.
The tests use a disposable project and real GTK3/Motif controls; they do not certify historical visual fidelity or other toolkit adapters.
No personal profile, user project, VM, or approved Downloads backup was modified.
